# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report a security problem in a public issue, a pull request or
on Discord. Report it privately instead, either way works:

- on GitHub: the **Security** tab of this repository, then **Report a vulnerability**
- by email: [support@spoolmanscale.com](mailto:support@spoolmanscale.com)

Please include the version you run, what you found and the steps to
reproduce it. I will reply as soon as I can and let you know when a fix is
out.

## Supported versions

Fixes go into the next release. Please check the latest release before you
report; older versions do not get separate fixes.

## Scope

This repository: the service on the Raspberry Pi, its web page, the installer
and the system files it puts in place. A problem in Spoolman, FilaMan or
BamBuddy themselves belongs to that project.
